name: Langhirano (Italy)
description: Quartered red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Langhirano (red and white chequy panels on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Langhirano, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Langhirano arms — red and white chequy panels on blue, crowned, within branches
